title: fix: honor backpressure in decompression interceptor

target.summary: The call to super.onResponseData in DecompressHandler.#drainOutput is not guarded with a try-catch block. If a downstream handler throws an error, the exception escapes instead of being caught and converted into a per-request error.
notes: faulty statement: super.onResponseData is called without a try-catch block to handle downstream errors
copy of the same faulty pattern: super.onResponseEnd is called without a try-catch block
